description: Use this when the user asks where a URL redirects, or whether there is a loop. Follows the public http(s) redirect chain (status per hop, final URL). Read-only, powered by Lanetti Tools.

url.description: Public http(s) URL or bare domain, e.g. https://example.com/path. Localhost, private and metadata addresses are rejected.
